name: Sign in, discover Doria and retain profile changes
covers: server-persisted profile display name and bio
description: Verifies account restoration, public game discovery and durable profile updates.
steps: Open Doria and sign in or create an account
Complete username setup if requested
Search for a published public game and apply a genre filter
Verify private or unpublished games are not present in Discover
Open Profile, update display name and bio, save, then refresh
Open the Privacy Policy and review its sections
Sign out and sign back in with the same account
Verify the saved username and profile fields remain available
expected: The player can sign in, discover only public published games, and retain profile changes across sessions.

name: Create and publish Neo and Baseplate worlds
covers: saved Baseplate object rendering in the 3D world viewer
description: Verifies both game creation paths save their content and expose the correct published world experience.
steps: Sign in as Actor A and open Doria Studio
Choose Use Neo and enter a game name, genre and gameplay description
Generate and publish the game
Verify the game appears in Actor A's creations as published
Verify Actor A earns the World Maker achievement
Sign in as Actor B and verify the new game appears in Discover
Open the Neo game and interact with its main control
Verify the account's daily unique play count is recorded once even if the same player reopens the world
Create a second world using Start from Baseplate and place at least two objects
Publish the Baseplate world, open it from Discover and verify the saved objects render in the 3D viewer
expected: Neo output runs in an isolated sandbox, published listings are shared, daily unique play metrics are recorded once per account, and Baseplate objects persist and render in the creator-world viewer.

name: Protect administrator access and player safety workflows
description: Verifies privileged actions require a verified administrator account and player safety controls remain server-enforced.
steps: Open Doria Admin Portal while signed out and attempt a protected action
Sign in with an administrator email from the configured verified-email allowlist
Open Games, edit a game description and save it
Delete a test game after confirming the destructive action
Sign in with a normal non-admin account and verify admin APIs are denied
Create a guardian invitation, accept it from the matching signed-in email, and change a safety setting
Verify the player's restricted action is rejected by the backend
Submit a community report and verify an administrator can resolve it
expected: Only configured verified administrator accounts can access admin data and moderation actions; non-admin accounts remain denied and guardian controls are enforced by the backend.

name: Create UGC, publish badges and retain avatar appearance
description: Verifies creator assets, badges and player appearance are persisted and restored correctly.
steps: Sign in and open Avatar Studio
Add multiple 3D shapes, change colours and scales, and inspect the rotating preview
Name the item, set a Starlits price and publish it
Refresh the marketplace and verify the model and its part count remain visible
Open Doria Studio and create a named badge attached to the creator's published game
Choose a graphic medal style and upload a valid PNG, JPG or WebP badge image
Publish the badge and verify it appears in the badge gallery
Choose a body colour, glow colour and accessory in Avatar Studio and save
Reload Doria and verify the saved avatar appearance is restored from the account
Submit an unsupported avatar colour to the avatar endpoint and verify the request is rejected
expected: UGC models and badges persist, supported game badges are awarded, and valid avatar preferences restore across sessions while invalid preferences are rejected.

name: Purchase a gamepass from inside its game
covers: speed, jump or crystal gameplay effect
description: Verifies a creator-defined gamepass is only purchasable in its own game and grants its configured effect.
setup: Actor A publishes a game and creates a speed boost or double crystals gamepass for it.
steps: Sign in as Actor B with enough Starlits
Open Actor A's game and open Gamepasses from the in-game header
Purchase the creator's pass
Verify it changes to Owned without leaving the game
Start or restart the supported voxel game and verify the pass effect is active
Close and reopen the game and verify ownership remains
Attempt to purchase the same pass while submitting a different game id and verify the server rejects the request
expected: The pass is purchased once, Starlits are deducted once, ownership persists, the effect applies in the correct game, and cross-game purchase attempts are rejected.
